responsibility: This file implements the core of GCC’s selftest framework itself. It provides pass/fail accounting and aborting assertion helpers, string-comparison utilities backing ASSERT_* macros, RAII wrappers for temporary files and fixed diagnostic quote marks, helpers for reading and locating selftest fixture files, the test_runner summary printer, and a small set of selftests validating the framework and selected libiberty helpers.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file is the core implementation of the general selftest framework declared in gcc/selftest.h, defining pass/fail behavior, string-check helpers, temp-file and quote-fixing utilities, fixture loading, runner reporting, and the framework’s own selftests.
